representative_text: I need to prepare a complete brachytherapy treatment plan for a 62-year-old female with stage IIB cervical cancer who has completed EBRT 45 Gy in 25 fractions with concurrent cisplatin. Post-EBRT MRI shows residual disease. She has a tandem and ovoid applicator in place. Walk me through the complete workflow from applicator placement verification to plan optimization, including imaging, dose prescription, OAR constraints, and plan evaluation.
